stories.title: Multiple US military aircraft damaged in Iranian strikes on air base in Jordan
stories.reason: An A-10 Warthog lost a wing and roughly eight F-15s sustained damage at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base, the first confirmed damage to US military hardware since Iran's missile barrage on Jordan two days ago, marking a sharp escalation in the war's reach.

stories.title: Supreme Court blocks Missouri's GOP-favored congressional map for the second time this week
stories.reason: The unsigned emergency order forces Missouri to use its 2022 map rather than a Trump-backed redraw that would have eliminated a Kansas City Democratic seat, a setback for the GOP's mid-decade redistricting push ahead of November's midterms.

stories.title: Putin arrives in Delhi for BRICS summit, holds bilateral talks with Modi in first such appearance since the Ukraine war began
stories.reason: The visit, aimed at pushing India-Russia trade toward $100 billion, underscores how sanctions and Western isolation attempts have failed to sideline Moscow as it deepens ties with major non-Western economies.

stories.title: Microsoft plans to triple data-center capacity to 38 gigawatts by 2032 to end AI bottlenecks
stories.reason: Capacity shortages have already forced Microsoft to turn away cloud and AI customers, and the buildout implies capital spending north of $175 billion this year alone as hyperscalers race to keep pace with demand.

stories.title: Oracle's cloud infrastructure revenue surges 121% as it books $30 billion in new AI contracts
stories.reason: The results, which beat estimates and pushed Oracle's backlog to $664 billion, show the AI infrastructure boom is still accelerating even as some investors question whether hyperscaler spending has outrun demand.

stories.title: Anthropic details how it disrupted a Russian espionage campaign and blocked a bioweapons-linked request to Claude
stories.reason: The threat-intelligence report, covering misuse disrupted between December 2025 and August 2026, also flags state-linked distillation attempts from seven China-based labs, illustrating how frontier AI has become both a security tool and a target.

stories.title: Wall Street braces for today's CPI print, the last inflation read before the Fed's September 16 decision
stories.reason: Economists expect headline inflation at 3.4% year-over-year after Wednesday's in-line producer price data failed to calm bond markets, leaving the report as the swing factor for whether the Fed hikes or holds next week.

stories.title: Second mathematician accuses OpenAI of dishonesty over how it credited outside work in its Millennium Prize claim
stories.reason: Andreas Thom's allegation lands days after NYU's Tristan Buckmaster made a similar claim, deepening scrutiny of OpenAI's celebrated Navier-Stokes breakthrough and its practice of drawing on unpublished outside research.
